title: Removes the `include_and_require` value when creating invoices
summary: The pending_invoice_items_behavior parameter on Create an invoice no longer supports the include_and_require value. When the parameter is omitted, the default value of pending_invoice_items_behavior is now exclude.

migrationNotes.text: Pending invoice items are no longe automatically included, giving you more control and flexibility in managing pending invoice items when creating invoices.

sources.quote: | [Removes the `include_and_require` value when creating invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2022-08-01/removes-include-require-value-invoices.md) | Invoicing | Breaking | api |

The `pending_invoice_items_behavior` parameter on [Create an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/create.md?api-version=2024-06-20) no longer supports the `include_and_require` value. When the parameter is omitted, the default value of `pending_invoice_items_behavior` is now `exclude`.
